About Alexandra

Who I am and what inspires me

95% Satisfaction Rate
95% Instructor Retention Rate
4000+ Learners Served Annually
13+ Years of Intuitive Practice

You Already Know What You're Capable Of. Let's Make Sure the World Does, Too.

If you've landed here, chances are you're searching for something: clarity, strategy, a stronger voice, or simply a way forward that doesn't feel like you have to figure it out alone. Maybe you're a family trying to navigate a system that wasn't built for you. Maybe you're a team that needs learning to actually land. Maybe you're an individual at a crossroads, trying to see what's next. Whatever brought you here, you're in the right place.

I grew up in a household where education was liberation, questioning was a sacred practice, and there was a deep commitment to Tikkun Olam, the Jewish concept of healing the world. I come from a family of educators, both professional and non-traditional, and I wanted to be a teacher for as long as I can remember. Not because it was expected, but because I could always see the potential in people, especially when they couldn't see it in themselves.

That instinct led me into the classroom, into instructional design and professional development, into advocacy, into corporate training spaces, into communities big and small. Over more than a decade as a special education teacher grades 6–12, faculty instructional coach, and Senior Instructional Designer with the NYC DOE DREAM Program, I helped inspire, empower, and drive real outcomes, including a 95% satisfaction rate among students, families, and educators I've worked with. But the numbers only tell part of the story. The real work was always people-first: see their strengths, celebrate their needs, build their confidence, give them the knowledge and tools to be the most brilliant version of themselves, and we were always going to succeed.

Here's the rub: even as I made that feel effortless for others, I struggled to give myself the same grace. The perfectionism I taught others to release, the vulnerability I welcomed in every room, I couldn't offer those to myself. No matter how fiercely I believed in everyone else, believing in myself felt impossible. That's where tarot found me, not as mysticism for its own sake, but as a framework. A way to clarify, process, and reflect on feelings and patterns that more traditional approaches couldn't quite reach. What started as a personal practice became, over 13+ years, a professional one, and one that quietly transformed everything else I do.

Whether I'm designing curriculum, advocating in an IEP meeting, producing an AI training webinar, copyediting an article, or sitting across from someone with a deck of cards, I'm doing the same thing every time: helping you find the clarity, courage, and tools to move forward. Now here I am, celebrating the messiness of innovation and the courage to feel the fear and do it anyway. Working together is an opportunity to actualize potential, find success through creativity and determination, and build something none of us could have built alone.

I work with children ages 0–99 (yes, really), teachers, service providers, school administrators, leaders, teams, organizations, anyone who is open and willing to dream big, find courage through fear, and believe that collaboration is foundational to transformation. If that's you, I'd love to connect.

✨Together, let's make the steps towards creating personal and collective worlds we are proud to be in. ✨
